description: Source code for a Linux kernel GPIO Button Hotplug driver, managing GPIO-based button events, including handling interrupts, polling, and uevent broadcasting.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a formatted variable string to a uevent skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills a uevent with button event variables.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Handles the work of broadcasting a button event via netlink.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map array.

methods.name: gpio_button_get_value
methods.description: Reads GPIO value, considering sleep capability and active_low configuration.

methods.name: gpio_keys_handle_button
methods.description: Processes button state change and generates corresponding event.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_queue_work
methods.description: Schedules polling work for GPIO buttons.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_poll
methods.description: Polls GPIO buttons and handles their state.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_close
methods.description: Stops polling work and disables IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_work_func
methods.description: Handles IRQ work for GPIO buttons.

methods.name: button_handle_irq
methods.description: IRQ handler that debounces and processes button IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_keys_get_devtree_pdata
methods.description: Parses device tree for GPIO button configuration.

methods.name: gpio_keys_button_probe
methods.description: Probes and initializes GPIO buttons, requesting GPIOs and IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_keys_probe
methods.description: Main driver probe function, sets up IRQs for buttons.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_probe
methods.description: Sets up polling for GPIO buttons.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_close
methods.description: Disables IRQs and cancels polling work.

methods.name: gpio_keys_remove
methods.description: Removes driver and cleans up resources.

methods.name: gpio_button_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers GPIO button drivers.

methods.name: gpio_button_exit
methods.description: Unregisters GPIO button drivers.
